title: rplC, rrl, and linezolid
dek: Linezolid occupies the 50S peptidyl-transferase centre. Resistance is still uncommon: rplC (L3, often C154R) and rrl 23S mutations. Myelosuppression, not rplC, is what usually stops the drug.
story: Linezolid is an oxazolidinone that binds the 50S A-site pocket and blocks initiation/elongation. In Mtb, the practical resistance genes are rplC (ribosomal protein L3; C154R is the celebrity missense) and rrl (23S rRNA, notably G2814T/A, G2270T/C and kin in Mtb numbering — always state the scheme).

Because Mtb has a single rRNA operon, rrl alleles can fix without the multi-copy dilution you see in E. coli. They remain uncommon in many surveys — LZD pressure is newer than RIF pressure. That prior will move as BPaLM scales.
cfr-like methyltransferases are the Gram-positive plasmid story; they are not the Mtb clinic. Do not import a Staph board question into a BAM.
deepTitle: Toxicology is part of resistance ecology
deep: 600 mg daily is the WHO BPaLM dose because 1200 mg cured in Nix-TB and also lesioned bone marrow and nerves. TDM trough <2 µg/mL is a practical target in some US overlays.
Stopping LZD early because of neuropathy without a replacement Group A drug is how BPaL becomes two drugs.
Catalogue 2nd ed still has few LZD-associated variants (single-digit in the first jump). Uncertain alleles should stay uncertain.
tedizolid is a related oxazolidinone, not a WHO backbone.

visual.caption: LZD resistance is sparse and ribosomal. Treat rplC/rrl hits as regimen-changing; treat WT as a prior that toxicity may still interrupt.

example.title: C154R at month 4 of BPaL
example.setup: Pre-XDR on BPaL. Month 4 tNGS: rplC C154R AF 0.70. Still smear-positive.

steps.title: LZD is lost
steps.body: C154R is the canonical L3 allele. Do not continue counting LZD.

steps.title: This is now a two-drug skeleton if Pa and BDQ are all that’s left
steps.body: Rebuild immediately. Two drugs in a still-positive RR case is how you lose BDQ next.

steps.title: Check the other Group A
steps.body: Sequence Rv0678/atpE and ddn/fbi again. Failures cluster.

example.takeaway: A late rplC hit is a regimen emergency, not a lab curiosity.
